notes: The Flashlight works everywhere now (Mods > Converted, on). In singleplayer craft it - iron ingots around a yellow glass pane, a comparator and a block of redstone - or use /flashlight; batteries are crafted from iron nuggets, gold ingots, iron ingots and a block of redstone. On servers with the HybridFlashlight plugin everyone sees your beam. On any other server press G for a flashlight only you can see (Controls > Misc to change the key).

Player Locator works without its plugin: on any server, and with friends in your singleplayer world, it points to the players near you. Servers with the HybridLocator plugin still share locations from anywhere in the world.
The Mods screen says where each mod works instead of naming a server.
